//: markdownlint config for this repo. Read by the `markdownlint` entry in
nvim/lua/plugins/lint.lua (via nvim-lint) and by the binary directly.
Default rules produce 443 violations across docs/ here, and almost all
of them are markdownlint judging mkdocs-material syntax by CommonMark
rules. Each disable below is because the rule is WRONG for this repo,
not because it was inconvenient -- re-check if docs/ ever stops being
Rules NOT disabled on purpose: MD040 (fenced blocks need a language,
or they lose syntax highlighting) and MD030 (list marker spacing).
//MD060: table-column-style: wants every table's delimiter row padded to the column width. 229 hits, purely cosmetic, and `theme` regenerates some of these tables.
//MD033: no-inline-html: mkdocs-material uses raw HTML for <kbd>, icons and grid cards. 87 hits, all intentional.
//MD032: blanks-around-lists: admonition bodies are indented 4 spaces, which this rule reads as a list inside a code block. 41 false positives.
//MD022: blanks-around-headings: same cause as MD032 -- headings nested inside `!!!` blocks and `===` content tabs.
//MD046: code-block-style: wants one style throughout, but Material needs indented blocks inside admonitions and fenced blocks elsewhere. Both are correct here.
//MD013: line-length: prose is soft-wrapped by the editor (see the 'prose' autocmd), and tables legitimately run long.
//MD024: no-duplicate-heading: content tabs repeat the same heading under different parents, which is fine. Only flag true siblings.
//MD041: first-line-heading: mkdocs pages may open with front matter or a Material grid directive rather than an h1.
